findings.summary: Skip-to-main-content link reported as clipped at left:-10000 — expected off-screen skip link, not a layout defect.
Narrow Today/Library show PWA install prompt overlapping bottom content area; bottom nav remains visible.
Library at 320px shows Signed out / Not connected while Create and Write note remain visible — expected for anonymous shell; authenticated journeys unverified in this capture.
No horizontal document overflow (overflowX=0) on captured routes/viewports. Professional icons observed in chrome; no app-authored emoji in sampled chrome.
